tools.name: ghl_agency_connection_health
tools.description: Check HighLevel Agency MCP connection health, active Safe-Writes Policy preset, and progressive discovery status. Example: ghl_agency_connection_health({"context":"moosh-growth","includeDoctor":true})

tools.name: ghl_agency_tools_search
tools.description: Search HighLevel automation blueprint presets and configuration templates by keyword or category. Example: ghl_agency_tools_search({"query":"funnel","category":"onboarding"})

tools.name: ghl_agency_tools_enable
tools.description: Configure the active Safe-Writes Policy preset (read-only, dry-run-first, or standard) for the current HighLevel agency session. Example: ghl_agency_tools_enable({"policyPreset":"dry-run-first"})

tools.name: ghl_agency_contexts
tools.description: List configured HighLevel agency account contexts and known sub-account locations without mutating state. Example: ghl_agency_contexts({"context":"moosh-growth"})

tools.name: ghl_agency_doctor
tools.description: Verify HighLevel agency Private Integration Token (PIT), CRM session, company, and seed location readiness. Example: ghl_agency_doctor({"context":"moosh-growth"})

tools.name: ghl_agency_locations
tools.description: Inspect a HighLevel sub-account location profile, timezone, and readiness configuration without mutating state. Example: ghl_agency_locations({"context":"moosh-growth","location":"loc_123"})

tools.name: ghl_snapshot_diff_audit
tools.description: Compare a live HighLevel client sub-account against a reference Master Snapshot without overwriting assets. Example: ghl_snapshot_diff_audit({"locationId":"loc_123","snapshotId":"snap_456"})

tools.name: ghl_site_builder_sync
tools.description: Synchronize a HighLevel funnel step layout while preserving 2-step carts and 1-click upsells. Example: ghl_site_builder_sync({"locationId":"loc_123","funnelId":"fnl_1","dryRun":true})

tools.name: ghl_domain_ssl_onboard
tools.description: Plan, verify, and attach HighLevel custom funnel domains and branded short-link CNAME/A/TXT records with SSL checks. Example: ghl_domain_ssl_onboard({"locationId":"loc_123","domain":"go.example.com","dryRun":true})

tools.name: ghl_workflow_ivr_builder
tools.description: Synthesize and publish HighLevel workflows, LeadShield contact form spam guards, and call-screening IVRs. Example: ghl_workflow_ivr_builder({"locationId":"loc_123","preset":"leadshield-form-guard","dryRun":true})

tools.name: ghl_custom_values_audit
tools.description: Read-only audit of sub-account Custom Values and SMS/email templates for broken merge tags or missing placeholders. Example: ghl_custom_values_audit({"locationId":"loc_123"})

tools.name: ghl_phone_wallet_audit
tools.description: Read-only audit of sub-account LC Phone numbers, number pools, forwarding loops, and unassigned monthly wallet drain. Example: ghl_phone_wallet_audit({"locationId":"loc_123"})

tools.name: ghl_user_role_governance
tools.description: Read-only audit of sub-account staff permissions against least-privilege role presets (va-support, sales-rep, client-admin, agency-admin). Example: ghl_user_role_governance({"locationId":"loc_123","preset":"va-support"})

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "ghl_agency_connection_health" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "ghl_agency_contexts" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ghl_custom_values_audit · Private data: ghl_agency_doctor, ghl_domain_ssl_onboard, ghl_workflow_ivr_builder, ghl_phone_wallet_audit · Public sink: ghl_workflow_ivr_builder, ghl_custom_values_audit · Destructive: ghl_agency_tools_enable.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ghl_custom_values_audit · Private data: ghl_agency_doctor, ghl_domain_ssl_onboard, ghl_workflow_ivr_builder, ghl_phone_wallet_audit · Public sink: ghl_workflow_ivr_builder, ghl_custom_values_audit · Destructive: ghl_agency_tools_enable

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
